policy_summary.activation: When not channeling, begin a 10.6-second casting state. Retriggering Flame during that state clears cooldown. At 6 seconds set the 10-second cooldown; exiting or being silenced or stunned cancels effects and starts cooldown.
policy_summary.payload: Select one eligible player ground unit; each half-second packet contains normal arts health damage at 12% ATK and independent FIRE damage at 6% ATK.
policy_summary.death: Unsilenced prezero enters a 3-second dead-like state. The explosion damages player ground targets, other qualified flame enemies and pillars through separate source selectors, then force-kills its owner with no actor source.

native_mapping_status: Independent packet and movement clocks implemented in isolated prototype; cast state and cooldown ownership plus the five-child death chain remain required.
first_hit_offset: The prose does not prove the first hit offset; explicit replaceable motion/contact policy must be bound separately.
